agent_explanation: Body gains rightward velocity after interacting with wall/floor and with dt=0.0164 moves ~0.044 per step at ~2.7 m/s. At x~19.04 near step 190 it is within arena, but in next ~4 steps it crosses the right boundary. Position correction / substepping insufficient at this dt allows centre+radius to exceed 20+0.15 tolerance, violating in_arena at step 194. Reducing dt to 0.005 provides sufficient resolution to keep body inside arena.
